sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Postclypeus almost black in dorsal view, becoming rust orange toward the frontal margin, occiput yellow. Head elongate in dorsal view, sides parallel, frons broad and shallow, frontal margin faint. Eye spots distinct, unpigmented. Mandibles entirely black. Pronotum yellow, anterior margin brown. Frons at about 43° below the vertex in profile. Rugae of the frons and vertex reduced. Frontal horns stout, projecting forward. Genal horns prominent in dorsal view, at about 45° to the anterolateral direction. Apical part of the mandibles curved about 60–65° relative to the longitudinal axis of the mandibular blade, tooth row distinct, with rounded prominent mandibular mounds: the left mound larger than the right. Postmentum slightly constricted at the middle, cup-shaped. Antennal segment 3 enlarged and sclerotized, formula 2<3>4=5=6, 11-segmented in total. Pronotum as wide as the head; anterior margin notched.
